program: [ quote [ eq? ] cat ] map [ [ false eq? ] cat ] map swap [ filter ] fold
notes: Map each y to the 4-atom filter (y eq? false eq?) in two stages, then fold [ filter ] over those filters starting from xs: one removal pass per value of the second list. #155's fused-body version had a 7-atom body and a 12-op segment.

program: dup [ quote ] map [ [ cons ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map swap true cons [ quote ] map [ [ eq? ] cat ] map [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold uncons drop [ i false eq? ] filter [ uncons swap drop ] map
notes: Lag-1 queue zip: actions (x cons quote cat) over the queue of tests (p eq?) built from (true . xs) give per position the code (x p eq?); drop the one leftover test, keep positions whose code is false (x differs from its predecessor; true never equals an int), take x. Empty input works.

program: [ quote [ add ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map swap [ 0 swap sub ] map [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold dup [ 0 swap sub ] map cat dup [ quote ] map [ [ lt? ] cat ] map [ [ false eq? ] cat ] map swap [ filter ] fold uncons swap drop
notes: Queue zip of actions (y add quote cat) over the negated xs gives the aligned differences y - x (negating xs is the map that puts the list swap in a closed segment); the gaps beside their negations; then max by folding the 4-atom filters (v lt? false eq?) over that list.

program: swap dup [ quote ] map [ [ lt? ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map swap [ swap ] dip dup 0 [ dup mul add ] fold [ swap drop ] swap cons map swap [ quote cat ] fold [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold [ true eq? ] filter 0 [ drop 1 add ] fold
notes: Actions (x lt? quote cat) from xs run over the queue ys padded with n copies of S = sum of x^2, which no x exceeds (x <= x^2), so padded positions never win and the queue never runs dry; count the true verdicts (leftover queue ints are never true). S replaces #155's max(xs) pad because it costs one fold instead of three filter stages; it is data-derived, not a sampler bound. Empty lists work.

program: 0 0 [ quote ] dip cons swap [ quote ] map [ [ cons ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map swap [ drop nil ] map [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold uncons [ uncons swap drop ] dip [ quote [ add ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map dup [ swap ] dip swap [ 0 swap sub ] map [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold [ quote ] map [ [ 0 lt? ] filter ] map [ 0 [ sub ] fold ] map [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold nil [ cons ] fold
notes: Deal xs into reversed evens A and odds B (rotation fold of (x cons quote cat) over two empty buckets; the buckets come from a (0 0) placeholder mapped to nil, because a seed pushed after the actions would overrun the 8-op segment), zip actions (a add quote cat) over -B to get z = a - b, turn z into -min(z, 0) with quote/filter-negative/0-sub-fold, rerun the same actions over that to get a - min(a - b, 0) = max, reverse. 117 ops against #155's 63; empty input works.
